metadata.title: Integration Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for establishing baseline trust, accountability, and eligibility for system-to-system integrations.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Integration platforms, message brokers, service meshes, non-human identities, and inter-system trust boundaries.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational pattern defining trust eligibility and non-equivalence for system-to-system integrations within a Zero Trust architecture.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines integration trust as data assertions governing propagation of effects across systems, not as permission or authority.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Primary control catalog governing non-human identity, access control, auditability, and system interconnection (AC, IA, AU, PL families).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust Architecture principles asserting that trust between systems is conditional, contextual, and explicitly mediated.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Establishes expectations for auditability and accountability of system-to-system interactions.

metadata.remarks: Integration Core defines when and how systems may participate in trusted integrations. This pattern establishes baseline eligibility, identity, and trust boundaries but does not authorize message formats, delivery semantics, business logic, or trust amplification.

components.title: Integration Identity and Ownership
components.description: Ensures integrations have explicit non-human identities, ownership, and accountability.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of unmanaged or anonymous system identities to invoke downstream effects.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit non-human identity binding establishes accountability.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Non-human system entities are uniquely identified and authenticated.
Integration ownership and responsibility are formally defined.

components.title: Integration Trust Boundary
components.description: Defines explicit trust boundaries between producing and consuming systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Exploitation of implicit trust across system boundaries.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit boundary declaration prevents trust overreach.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Authorization is explicitly enforced at system integration boundaries.

components.title: Integration Non-Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what integration participation does not grant or imply.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Non-equivalence guarantees prevent over-trust of integration effects.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integration participation does not imply privilege, authorization, or entitlement.
